# NFC South NFL Statistics Project

This analysis examines the Carolina Panthers, Tampa Bay Buccaneers, New Orleans Saints, and Atlanta Falcons from 2018 through 2022. The goal is to investigate how home-field advantage and officiating changed during the 2020 COVID season.

## Step 1: Load Packages

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(nflreadr)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(naniar)
```

## Step 2: Load NFC South Game Data

```{r nfc_south_schedule}
# NFC South teams
my_division <- c("CAR", "TB", "NO", "ATL")

# Load regular-season games from 2018-2022
clean_schedule <- load_schedules(2018:2022) %>%
  filter(
    location == "Home",
    game_type == "REG",
    home_team %in% my_division | away_team %in% my_division
  ) %>%
  select(
    game_id, season, home_team, away_team,
    home_score, away_score, result, location, roof
  )

# Display the first six games
head(clean_schedule)
```
```{r}

# Load play-by-play data for 2018-2022
my_pbp <- load_pbp(2018:2022) %>%
  filter(
    game_id %in% clean_schedule$game_id,
    !is.na(play_type)
  ) %>%
  select(
    game_id, posteam_type, epa, penalty,
    penalty_type, penalty_team, penalty_yards,
    pass_attempt, rush_attempt, yards_gained,
    play_type, down, ydstogo, qtr,
    score_differential
  )

# Preview the play-by-play data
head(my_pbp)

```
```{r}

# Combine play-by-play data with game schedules
nfc_south_df <- my_pbp %>%
  left_join(clean_schedule, by = "game_id")

# Display the first six rows
head(nfc_south_df)

# Check the size of our dataset
dim(nfc_south_df)

```
```{r}

# Identify which side committed each penalty
nfc_south_df <- nfc_south_df %>%
  mutate(
    penalized_side = case_when(
      penalty_team == home_team ~ "Home",
      penalty_team == away_team ~ "Away",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Count penalties by home and away teams
table(nfc_south_df$penalized_side, useNA = "ifany")

```
```{r}

# Identify games played during the COVID season
nfc_south_df <- nfc_south_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_covid_year = if_else(season == 2020, 1, 0)
  )

# Compare home and away penalty counts by season
penalties_by_season <- nfc_south_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(penalized_side)) %>%
  count(season, penalized_side) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = penalized_side,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = Away - Home
  ) %>%
  arrange(season)

# Display results
print(penalties_by_season)

```
```{r}

# Calculate the percentage of penalties against away teams
penalty_percentages <- penalties_by_season %>%
  mutate(
    total_penalties = Away + Home,
    away_penalty_pct = round(Away / total_penalties * 100, 2),
    home_penalty_pct = round(Home / total_penalties * 100, 2)
  )

# Display the results
print(penalty_percentages)

```
```{r}

# Graph: Home vs Away Penalty Percentages
ggplot(
  penalty_percentages,
  aes(x = factor(season))
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = away_penalty_pct, color = "Away"),
    group = 1,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = away_penalty_pct, color = "Away"),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = home_penalty_pct, color = "Home"),
    group = 1,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = home_penalty_pct, color = "Home"),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NFC South: Home vs Away Penalties (2018-2022)",
    subtitle = "Comparing penalty percentages before, during, and after COVID",
    x = "NFL Season",
    y = "Percentage of Penalties",
    color = "Team Location"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}

# Calculate NFC South home winning percentages by season
home_win_stats <- clean_schedule %>%
  filter(home_team %in% my_division) %>%
  mutate(
    home_win = if_else(home_score > away_score, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(
    home_games = n(),
    home_wins = sum(home_win),
    home_win_pct = round(mean(home_win) * 100, 2),
    avg_home_margin = round(mean(result, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Display results
print(home_win_stats)

```
```{r}

# Graph: NFC South Home Winning Percentage
ggplot(home_win_stats, aes(x = factor(season),
                           y = home_win_pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(home_win_pct, "%")),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NFC South Home Winning Percentage (2018-2022)",
    subtitle = "Home-field advantage before, during, and after COVID",
    x = "NFL Season",
    y = "Home Winning Percentage"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 70) +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}

# Compare 2020 home wins with all other seasons
home_win_test_data <- clean_schedule %>%
  filter(home_team %in% my_division) %>%
  mutate(
    period = if_else(season == 2020, "COVID 2020", "Other Seasons"),
    outcome = if_else(home_score > away_score, "Win", "Loss")
  )

# Create a table of wins and losses
win_table <- table(
  home_win_test_data$period,
  home_win_test_data$outcome
)

print(win_table)

# Perform Fisher's exact test
fisher.test(win_table)

```
When I compared NFC South home winning percentages during the 2020 season against the other four seasons, I got a p-value of 0.8446. Since that's greater than 0.05, the difference wasn't statistically significant. Based on our data, we couldn't conclude that home teams performed differently during the COVID season.
